unit_attributes.statement: For application review, a review notice (RN) means a written request for missing application records.
In the context of application review, applicants must return the review notice (RN) within ten days unless a reviewer extends the deadline.
In the context of application review, reviewers may extend the deadline to return the review notice (RN) by five days only with a supervisor's approval.
Within equipment inspections, a review notice (RN) means a record that an inspection was completed; it is not a request for records.
Within equipment inspections, inspectors must issue a review notice (RN) after completing an inspection.
Within equipment inspections, operators may archive that review notice (RN) only after a manager's approval.
Within equipment inspections, where an RN is archived with manager approval, you must retain a copy of the approval email.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Within equipment inspections, regarding manager approval for archiving an RN

unit_attributes.statement: Under general record handling, records must be retained for two years.

document.text:
Constructed scoped-term controls — not an official document

Application review

For application review, a review notice (RN) means a written request for missing application records.

Applicants must return the RN within ten days unless a reviewer extends the deadline.

Reviewers may extend that deadline by five days only with a supervisor's approval.

Equipment inspection

Within equipment inspections, a review notice (RN) means a record that an inspection was completed; it is not a request for records.

Inspectors must issue an RN after completing an inspection.

Operators may archive that RN only after a manager's approval.

You must retain a copy of the approval email.

General record handling

Records must be retained for two years.

ZX is an external reference code whose meaning is not supplied here.
